name: tag-input
title: TagInput
description: Controlled multi-value tag editor. Renders one removable chip per tag (Badge + per-tag x button) plus a text input to add a new tag on Enter. Fully controlled (value: string[] + onChange). Dedup is built-in: adding an existing or empty/whitespace tag is a no-op; new tags are trimmed. disabled blocks add and remove. Optional suggestions power a native datalist (zero-dep autocomplete). Composes Input + Badge — no Combobox, no new dependency.
